_about: Public-domain Thomas Newton (1704-1782), Bishop of Bristol, for the Word Hoard: Dissertations on the Prophecies which have remarkably been fulfilled (London: Tonson, 1758-1759, three volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
